name: kamal-backup
description: Encrypted scheduled database and Active Storage backups packaged as a Kamal accessory.
details: Uses restic repositories and documented restore drills for Rails deployments, including PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite and files.
best_for: You run a Rails app on Kamal and need repeatable backups and restore testing.
caveat: Test a real restore and review retention and storage credentials before relying on backups.

name: Rails Conductor
description: Early-stage self-hosted Rails operations control plane with Kamal support.
details: Brings SSH execution, deployments, backups, metrics, and alerts into one interface for Docker/Kamal and native deployments.
best_for: You operate a mixed Rails infrastructure and want a self-hosted control plane.
caveat: The maintainers explicitly mark some features in progress; verify maturity.

name: DeployAngel
description: Ruby instrumentation for post-deployment behavior checks in Rails, Hanami, and Sinatra.
details: Collects aggregated application signals after releases to help confirm runtime behavior beyond a container being healthy.
best_for: You need application-level evidence a deployment is behaving normally.
caveat: Requires a Ruby agent and configured telemetry ingestion.

name: Automated CrowdSec Kamal
description: Community integration of CrowdSec security tooling with Kamal.
details: Illustrates ways to add intrusion detection and response around a containerized app stack.
best_for: You are evaluating host and edge security around Kamal.
caveat: Test firewall and security rules on disposable infrastructure first.

name: Shoestring
description: Self-hosted observability that combines SSH snapshots with kamal-proxy request logs.
details: Its boxwatch workflow produces HTML and agent-readable reports covering latency, errors, host resources, and container health.
best_for: You have a few machines and want local diagnostics without a hosted APM bill.
caveat: Requires log and SSH access; monitoring is not the same as managed alerting.

name: Upstate
description: Hosted Kamal production visibility with deploy receipts, observer health checks, and alerts.
details: Connects the signals from hosts, components, and deployments to help owners see whether their fleet is behaving as intended.
best_for: You manage several Kamal apps and want a single view of their operational health.
caveat: Commercial sponsor of this directory; sponsorship does not affect inclusion or order.
